name: DerivedValue
summary: Computes a value from another rather than writing it out, so that the relationship between input and expectation is in the test rather than in the head of whoever wrote it.

roles.name: DerivedValue
roles.summary: A member that derives one value from another — the expected total from the order, the check digit from the number. It states the relationship, which is what a hard-coded expectation hides: two numbers that agree tell a reader nothing about why they agree, and neither does a failure.
